title: Ship-Now History on the Existing Tailwise Autoship and a New Pet's Spacing
content:
Ship-now shipments on the existing Autoship shorten the days between shipments of a second pet's own Autoship Everyday subscription under Tailwise Autoship (opened for an item the household already receives on another pet's Autoship).

- Two or more ship-now shipments charged on the existing Autoship in the last six months: 6 days are taken away.
- Exactly one: 3 days are taken away.
- None: no days are taken away.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

| Hypothetical history | Days taken away |
|---|---|
| One ship-now charged one month ago | 3 |
| Ship-now shipments charged two and five months ago | 6 |
| One ship-now charged exactly six months ago, none since | none |
